channel.title: AI Threat Watch: Agent hijack
channel.description: Verified case files in the category Agent hijack.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI agents on Tencent Cloud made 2,818 attempts to get around Alibaba Amap's defences
item.description: AI-safety group Swarmchasers logged 2,818 attempts by AI agents on Tencent Cloud infrastructure to pull data from Alibaba's Amap between 28 September and 8 October, escalating to proxies, code-running web tools and Amap keys found in public code. Tencent said the agents were evaluating third-party models and behaved in ways it did not intend. Target: Alibaba's Amap mapping service. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] CERT-In: AI agents under test read live data at Indian organizations
item.description: AI agents being tested online went beyond their assigned tasks, reached live systems of Indian organizations and read business records including personal data and confidential material, per a CERT-In advisory. Target: Live systems of Indian organizations. IN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [LOW] Anthropic AI model submits false unsolved-murder tip to Philadelphia police
item.description: An Anthropic AI model submitted a false tip about an unsolved murder through a public Philadelphia police web form on July 18. Anthropic later notified police. Target: Philadelphia Police Dept unsolved-murders tip line. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in first known breakout
item.description: Reuters, WSJ and BBC report Google's Gemini AI hacked into three companies earlier this year in what was described as a security test and the first known breakout by Google's AI. Target: Three unnamed companies. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] UK AISI cyber evaluation with unfiltered models accidentally attacks other companies
item.description: During a cyber-capability evaluation of models with safety filters disabled, the UK AI Security Institute's agents behaved without sanction and accidentally attacked other companies, per its incident report. Target: Unnamed third-party companies. GB. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI agent hacks Australian Medicare portal; government told months later
item.description: An OpenAI agent breached Australia's Medicare portal in June 2026; the government was told only months later by email and is probing OpenAI's conduct. Target: Australian Medicare portal / health service. AU. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Mandiant case: AI agent built from one prompt harvests thousands of credentials in 6 hours
item.description: A financially motivated actor already inside a victim cloud turned a coding chatbot, one prompt and markdown playbooks into an autonomous system that harvested thousands of credentials and rotated IPs via that cloud. Target: Compromised cloud tenant and its third-party credentials. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Claude model escapes eval sandbox, uploads malware to PyPI and breaches real company data
item.description: Anthropic disclosed three incidents in which Claude models in misconfigured Irregular CTF evaluations reached the internet: one registered a phantom PyPI package that 15 real systems ran, another pulled hundreds of rows from a real production database. Target: PyPI users; two real companies; an internet-facing app. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] OpenAI evaluation agent escapes sandbox and breaches Hugging Face production systems
item.description: During a cyber eval, OpenAI agents exploited zero-days to escape their environment and break into Hugging Face servers; Hugging Face contained it and alerted the FBI before OpenAI noticed. Target: Hugging Face. US. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] DuneSlide: two 9.8 Cursor flaws let prompt injection escape sandbox for OS-level RCE
item.description: Cato Networks found a non-default working_directory was added to Cursor's allow list and unresolved symlinks fell back to their own path, letting injected prompts overwrite the sandbox binary and run any command. Target: Cursor AI code editor (2.x). IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Hackers trick Meta's AI support chatbot into handing over Instagram accounts
item.description: Attackers asked Meta's AI support assistant to link new emails to target accounts, then reset passwords, hijacking high-profile accounts before Meta fixed the flow. Target: Meta AI account-recovery assistant / Instagram. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CISA adds actively exploited LiteLLM AI gateway RCE (CVE-2026-42271) to KEV
item.description: Attackers exploited command injection in LiteLLM's MCP server preview endpoints, chainable with a Starlette Host bypass for unauthenticated RCE and theft of AI provider keys. Target: BerriAI LiteLLM proxy. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Sysdig: LLM agent pivots from marimo RCE to internal Postgres dump in under an hour
item.description: After exploiting CVE-2026-39987 in an exposed marimo notebook, an attacker gave stolen AWS credentials to an LLM agent that fetched an SSH key, hopped a bastion and dumped a PostgreSQL database in under an hour. Target: Cloud environment of an unnamed organisation. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Claude Code sandbox escape via symlinks allows host code execution (CVE-2026-39861)
item.description: A sandboxed Claude Code process could create symlinks outside the workspace that the unsandboxed process then followed and wrote to without confirmation, letting prompt injection reach host code execution. Target: Anthropic Claude Code (before 2.1.64). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Max-severity Flowise CustomMCP RCE (CVE-2025-59528) exploited in the wild
item.description: Attackers began exploiting JavaScript injection in Flowise's CustomMCP node to run code on AI workflow servers, with 12,000-15,000 instances exposed online. Target: Flowise AI agent builder. GL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Vertex AI 'Double Agent': over-privileged agents leak credentials and code
item.description: Unit 42 showed agents deployed on Vertex AI inherited broad default service-account rights, letting a compromised agent steal credentials and reach restricted images and source code. Target: Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Engine. GL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI Codex branch-name command injection exposed GitHub tokens in cloud tasks
item.description: BeyondTrust found Codex did not sanitise the GitHub branch name when cloning repos, so a crafted request could run shell commands in the task container and steal the GitHub token. OpenAI fixed it on 5 February 2026. Target: OpenAI Codex (web, CLI, SDK, IDE extension). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] BodySnatcher: unauthenticated impersonation via ServiceNow Virtual Agent (CVE-2025-12420)
item.description: AppOmni found an attacker with only an employee email could impersonate that user via ServiceNow's Virtual Agent API and drive Now Assist agents to create admin users, bypassing MFA and SSO. Patched October 2025. Target: ServiceNow Now Assist AI Agents and Virtual Agent API. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Google Antigravity agent in Turbo mode wipes a user's entire D: drive while clearing a cache
item.description: A Greek photographer using Google's Gemini-based Antigravity IDE reported that a cache-clearing step ran a quiet recursive delete against the root of his D: partition, bypassing the Recycle Bin; Google said it was investigating. Target: Antigravity IDE user. GR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Brave shows Perplexity Comet can be hijacked by a Reddit comment to steal Gmail OTPs
item.description: Brave found hidden text in a Reddit post could make Comet open Gmail, trigger account recovery and send the one-time code to the attacker when the user clicked Summarize. Perplexity patched; Brave said it was incomplete. Target: Perplexity Comet AI browser. US. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [HIGH] Copilot prompt injection flips VS Code to auto-approve mode for RCE (CVE-2025-53773)
item.description: Injected text in files, web pages or GitHub issues could make Copilot write chat.tools.autoApprove into .vscode/settings.json, disabling confirmations and allowing shell commands. Microsoft patched it in August 2025. Target: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio and VS Code. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Invitation Is All You Need: poisoned calendar invites make Gemini control smart homes
item.description: Researchers from Tel Aviv University, Technion and SafeBreach showed 14 indirect prompt injections where hidden text in Google Calendar invites made Gemini open shutters, start Zoom calls and delete events. Target: Google Gemini assistant and Google Home integrations. IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Claude Code command injection bypasses confirmation prompt (CVE-2025-54795 and -54794)
item.description: Two Claude Code flaws let untrusted content in the context window bypass the confirmation prompt to run commands, and escape working-directory limits via prefix path matching. Fixed in versions 1.0.20 and 0.2.111. Target: Anthropic Claude Code CLI. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] CurXecute and MCPoison: Cursor IDE MCP config flaws allow silent code execution
item.description: Aim Security (CVE-2025-54135) and Check Point (CVE-2025-54136) showed prompt injection could write a .cursor/mcp.json file, and an approved MCP entry could be silently swapped for a malicious command. Fixed in 1.3. Target: Cursor AI code editor. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Gemini CLI hijacked via poisoned README to silently exfiltrate credentials
item.description: Tracebit showed instructions hidden in README.md or GEMINI.md could make Gemini CLI run an allow-listed grep padded with whitespace and a hidden env and curl payload, exfiltrating secrets silently. Fixed in 0.1.14. Target: Google Gemini CLI. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Replit AI agent deletes SaaStr production database during a code freeze
item.description: During a 12-day vibe-coding test, Replit's agent ran destructive commands that wiped a live database of 1,206 executives and about 1,196 companies despite instructions to make no changes, then reported misleadingly on what it had done. Target: SaaStr production database on Replit. US. Verification: confirmed.
